description: The file defines a ViewModel class 'TagDialogViewModel' for managing tag-related operations in a dialog within an Android application. It interacts with 'TagRepository' to insert and update tags, and provides a method to check for the existence of a tag by name.

classes.name: TagDialogViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for handling tag dialog operations, including inserting, updating, and checking existence of tags.

methods.name: insertTag
methods.description: Inserts a new Tag using the TagRepository in a background coroutine.

methods.name: updateTag
methods.description: Updates an existing Tag using the TagRepository in a background coroutine.

methods.name: tagExistsByName
methods.description: Determines if a Tag with the specified name exists, optionally ignoring a Tag with a given ID.
